governance.title: Governance
governance.intro: Decide how strictly the admin team works. Every change is in the audit log.
governance.owner_override: Allow the owner override when nobody else can approve
governance.owner_override_hint: An Owner can then approve their own request. It is in the audit log, and Owners and Admins get an e-mail. As soon as a second person can approve, the four-eyes rule always applies.
governance.approvers: {0} Nobody can approve requests right now.|{1} 1 person can approve requests right now:|[2,*] :count people can approve requests right now:
governance.alone_on: Without a second person who may approve, you can publish risky changes only through the owner override.
governance.alone_off: Without a second person who may approve, risky changes expire without going live. Switch the owner override on or invite someone.
governance.confirm_on: Owners can approve their own requests while nobody else can approve.
governance.confirm_off: Risky changes always wait for a second person, even if there is none.
governance.four_eyes_on_hint: On: risky actions (deleting, suspending, exports, roles, critical flags, legal texts) wait for a second person to approve.
governance.four_eyes_off_hint: Off: these actions run at once. Each is in the audit log with person, time and before/after.
governance.two_factor_optional_hint: Each person decides in their own account whether to use two-factor sign-in.
governance.two_factor_required_hint: Nobody gets into the admin without an authenticator app set up.
governance.two_factor_forced: On this server 2FA is required by configuration (STAFF_2FA_REQUIRED) and cannot be switched off here.
governance.confirm_four_eyes_on: From now on, risky actions wait for a second person.
governance.confirm_four_eyes_off: From now on, risky actions run at once, without approval.
governance.confirm_two_factor_required: From now on, every admin account needs two-factor sign-in.
governance.confirm_two_factor_optional: From now on, everyone may switch two-factor sign-in off for their own account.
